faq.title: FAQ — PT Lobunta Mandiri Persada
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Questions we most often receive from project owners and partners.
faq.body:
Which business lines does PT Lobunta Mandiri Persada run?

We run three divisions: the Mining & Plant Division (ore and coal mining contracting), the Civil Construction Division (general contracting for roads, bridges, irrigation, buildings, and site development), and heavy equipment rental with trucking. We also provide general supply, crushing plant, and mixer plant.

Do you hold a mining service licence?

Yes. PT Lobunta Mandiri Persada holds mining service licence No. 26032401765630001 with NIB 9120002171281 and Grade 6 civil work contractor qualification.

Which equipment is available for rental?

Bulldozers, compactor dozers, excavators, wheel loaders, track loaders, vibrating rollers, pad foot rollers, motor graders, hydraulic breakers, 6x4 20 and 24 ton dump trucks, and barges for large volume delivery. Unit availability is maintained at a minimum of 85%.

Do you take site development work?

Yes. We have delivered smelter site development in Kendawangan for PT Well Harvest Wining Alumina Refinery and PT Kayong Aluminium Nusantara, plus the PLTU Pasuruan power plant site development with PLN and Mitsubishi Corporation.

How long has the company been operating?

It started as CV. Lobunta on 27 January 1973 and became PT. Lobunta Kencana Raya on 30 September 1977. LMP is the mining and civil construction division of the LOBUNTA Group.

How do I request a quotation or the company profile?

Send your project details through the Contact page or WhatsApp, or download our official company profile for procurement and partnership purposes.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This page explains how PT Lobunta Mandiri Persada collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacyPolicy.body:
Data we collect. We collect the name, phone number, email address, company, and message you send through the contact form or WhatsApp.

How we use it. The data is used to answer questions, prepare quotations, and manage project administration.

Sharing. We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.

Security. Data is stored on servers with restricted access and used only by authorised personnel.

Your rights. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data by contacting us through the contact page.

termsConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
termsConditions.heading: Terms & Conditions
termsConditions.intro: By using our services and browsing this site, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
termsConditions.body:
1. Scope. These terms govern the use of this site and the contracting services for mining, civil construction, and heavy equipment rental provided by PT Lobunta Mandiri Persada.

2. Quotations and contracts. A quotation is valid for the period stated. The work order becomes binding once signed by both parties, with the scope, volume, and contract value in writing.

3. Contract value. The contract value follows the site survey, production target, and work specification. Any change of scope may adjust the value.

4. Payment. Payment follows the scheme agreed in the contract, using bank transfer, letter of credit, or another method agreed in writing.

5. Execution time. The work schedule follows the agreed target and depends on site conditions, weather, and permits applicable at the project location.

6. HSE and environment. All work is executed with a zero accident principle, ISO and OHSAS compliance, and social and environmental contribution for communities around the site.

7. Limitation of liability. We are not liable for indirect losses arising from delays outside our control, including force majeure and third party disruptions.

8. Governing law. These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws in force in the Republic of Indonesia.
